items: Sundarbans — largest tidal mangrove forest in world; home to Royal Bengal Tiger; UNESCO World Heritage
Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve — designated by UNESCO; covers parts of WB and Bangladesh
East Kolkata Wetlands — Ramsar Site (2002); largest sewage-fed fisheries in world; east of Kolkata
Terai & Dooars — rich biodiversity; one-horned rhino, elephants, leopards; tea gardens
WB Forest Department — controls forest cover; WB has about 13.4% forest cover
Cyclone vulnerability — South WB coast (South 24 Parganas, East Medinipur) frequently hit by Bay of Bengal cyclones; Amphan (2020), Yaas (2021)
Air Pollution — Kolkata and industrial towns like Durgapur, Asansol have high air pollution
Ganga-Hooghly Pollution — Industrial effluents and sewage from Kolkata major pollutants
DVC (Damodar Valley Corporation) — India's first multipurpose river valley project; controls Damodar floods
Solar & Wind Energy — WB investing in renewable energy; Purulia pumped storage project

cells: UNESCO; Project Tiger; mangrove; Royal Bengal Tiger
